C. A. 3d Cir. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black would grant the petition for a writ of certiorari and reverse the judgment. Mr. Justice Douglas would grant the petition for a writ of certiorari and reverse the' judgment below on authority of Rogers v. Missouri Pacific R. Co., 352 U. S. 500.
